nom: e.l.f. Cosmetics Youth Boosting Blue-ty Sleep Night Oil

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the oil feels heavy or greasy and one describes a breakout, though others say it absorbed well and did not worsen shine.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers most consistently report visible relief from dryness, dry patches and dry itchy skin, with soft, hydrated results by morning.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the oil did not worsen their T-zone or hormonal breakouts and several describe it as effective and glow-giving.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and good hydration, though one describes redness around the nose that subsided quickly.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 40s-plus and 75 describe softer fine lines, smaller-looking pores and a firmer, silkier feel with continued use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report softer or reduced fine lines, smaller-looking pores and a firmer feel, especially with weeks of nightly use; one reviewer (mature, 4/5) saw texture and pore improvement but no drastic change in fine lines, and one 1-star review reports more visible lines and worse texture.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe noticeably more hydrated, soft, dewy skin by morning, including relief from long-standing dry patches and itchiness; no dissent found.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers credit the blue tansy formula with calming redness and reducing puffiness, and one sensitive-skin reviewer had temporary redness around the nose that resolved quickly.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with retinol sensitivity report the product as non-irritating and gentle even with nightly use, in contrast to other retinol products that burned or irritated their skin.
concerns.spots: One acne-prone reviewer reports no cystic breakouts for the first time with an oil, and another with a fear of oils breaking her out saw only minor blemishes that cleared fast; one oily-skin reviewer reports it did break her out.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts or none at all while using it nightly; one oily-skin reviewer is the exception, reporting a breakout she attributes to the product's heaviness.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers, including some with oily skin, describe the product sitting on the skin and feeling greasy for hours, while others (including some oily-skin users) say it is lightweight and non-greasy despite being an oil.

aspects.libelle: Good value, product lasts a long time
Hard to layer other skincare on top

extraits.texte: I'm almost at the end of my first bottle. I like the colour. I have been using alongside the bouncy night mask. It doesn't massage well into the skin. However, my skin is worse than when I started. More lines, more uneven texture and it just looks greasy. I have been using a daytime sunscreen. I did buy a second bottle but I'm not going to use it. Unfortunately Elf I am going back to my previous routine

extraits.titre: Smells nice, may be good for dry skin
extraits.texte: The oil smells pleasant and feels hydrating. It leaves my skin feeling too heavy, or a bit greasy though. It breaks me out unfortunately, but I do have oily skin so perhaps this product is simply too heavy for my skin. I did not notice any difference in comparison to any other product, though it has a pretty low percent of a retinoid.

extraits.titre: Good introduction to retinoids into skincare routi
extraits.texte: Unfortunately, I wasn't able to try this product myself, as I found out I was pregnant shortly after receiving it and chose to avoid retinoids during pregnancy. However, I did pass it along to a friend in exchange for her honest feedback—and overall, her experience was quite positive. She noticed a visible reduction in some of her finer lines and appreciated that the oil-based formula had a smooth dry-down without feeling sticky, which can be a common issue with similar products. Although she has very sensitive skin and experienced some redness around her nose, it subsided quickly and didn't cause any major irritation—especially compared to other products she's tried. All in all, this seems like a great option for anyone looking to gently introduce retinoids into their skincare routine.

I've been using this consistently for a month and have noticed a difference in the overall texture and smoothness of my 46 year old skin. My pores appear visibly smaller and there is some softening of the fine lines on my forehead. I use three drops under my night moisturizer and it sinks in with no greasy feeling. I'll continue to use this! It's been great.

I was soo afraid of this breaking me out because it's oil. And it feels like oil. Doesn't dry down much at all, which is great for my dry winter skin right now. But most oils break me out within hours! This one did not! And I actually woke up with a few small starting blemishes that lessened or even gone entirely after 1 use. I highly recommend.

I absolutely love this oil! I have combination skin so was worried that the oil would make my T-zone worse but it hasn't affected it at all. The dryer parts of my face feel so soft and velvety. The oil hasn't transferred on to my white pillowcase which is a massive bonus. I would highly recommend. A little goes a long way.

extraits.titre: Non greasy, great for acne prone skin
extraits.texte: This is the first oil I have been able to use without my cystic acne breaking out. I smooth it in at nighttime and my skin feels soft. No greasy residue and smells lovely.
